0022600117.text: The 76ers (3-0, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East) host the Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) in Philadelphia's fourth game of the season, with Philadelphia on a three-game winning streak and Detroit on a two-game one. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), Joel Embiid (heel), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and VJ Edgecombe (abdomen, bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Detroit is missing Jalen Duren (hamstring, strain) and Ausar Thompson (ankle, sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. This is the first meeting between the teams this season, following a 2025-26 season series in which the 76ers lost 0-4, including a 116-93 loss in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
